user.title: Soliom Home account
user.description: Sign in with the same e-mail and password you use in the Soliom Home app. Region is the two-letter country code of your Soliom account and the country calling code is used to select the correct cloud cluster.

data_description.password: Soliom Home account password (stored in the Home Assistant config entry).
data_description.region: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example US, GB or DE.
data_description.country_code: International calling code, for example 1 for US/Canada, 44 for the UK, 49 for Germany.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Soliom Home
reauth_confirm.description: The Soliom cloud rejected the stored credentials. Enter the password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: The e-mail or password was rejected by the Soliom cloud.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Soliom cloud.
error.api_error: The Soliom cloud returned an API error.

abort.already_configured: This Soliom account is already configured.

general.title: Polling interval
general.description: How often cloud device status and events are refreshed.

device_settings.title: Local settings for {device}
device_settings.description: Live view uses RTSP over your local network. Leave the host empty to disable local live view and controls. The cloud reports this camera's LAN address as: {ip}. {p2p_password_hint}

data_description.local_host: IP address or hostname of the camera on your LAN. You may include an HTTP port.
data_description.rtsp_password: Leave empty to use the camera password from your Soliom account.
data_description.rtsp_stream: 0 for the main stream, 1 for the sub stream.
data_description.local_https: Enable only if the camera's CGI interface uses HTTPS.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable for the self-signed certificates used by most cameras.

abort.no_devices: No Soliom devices were found for this account.
